headline: Turn scattered business records into dashboards, automation and clear decisions.
subheadline: We help growing businesses organize their data, track performance, automate repetitive reporting, and know exactly what needs attention every week.

services.title: Business dashboards
services.body: Google Sheets, Excel, Looker Studio or private web dashboards for sales, revenue, customers, staff, inventory and projects.

services.title: KPI & reporting systems
services.body: Define the numbers that matter, track them clearly, and generate daily, weekly or monthly management reports.

services.title: Data cleanup
services.body: Clean messy spreadsheets, remove duplicates, merge records, structure customer lists and prepare reliable reporting data.

services.title: AI workflow audit
services.body: Identify repetitive admin tasks, reporting delays, communication gaps and where AI can reduce manual work.

services.title: Automation strategy
services.body: Design workflows for reminders, customer follow-up, reports, forms, staff updates, email/SMS/WhatsApp sequences and management alerts.

services.title: Management insights
services.body: Turn raw data into action: what improved, what dropped, who needs follow-up, and what decision should be made next.
